by: session, Adrian 16 Oct 2026: 'put each common mistake at the end of its clip as a Watch out step'

beats.say: P equals P nought E to the power K T. It starts at one hundred and doubles every seven point five hours. Find K.
Starts at one hundred means T equals zero. So P nought is one hundred.
asks: Why is t = 0 at the start?

beats.say: Doubling means two times one hundred. At T equals seven point five, P is two hundred.
Two hundred equals one hundred E to the power seven point five K. The plan: get the E part alone, then take L N.
asks: Why get the e part alone first?

beats.say: Divide both sides by one hundred, so the E part stands alone. E to the power seven point five K equals two.
asks: Can I take ln straight away?

beats.say: E is involved, so take L N of both sides.
asks: Why is ln used when e is involved?

beats.say: L N E is one, so the power comes down. Seven point five K equals L N two.
asks: How does the power come down?

beats.say: So K equals L N two over seven point five, about zero point zero nine two four.
asks: How do I key this in?

beats.say: Watch out: P is two hundred, not two. Doubling one hundred gives two hundred.
